title: Cardinal Billing Account Pay Plan Schedule: Down Payment, Installments and Invoice Timing
content:
Every Cardinal Billing Account bills its policy term on one of six pay plans. The figures below are the plan figures the billing rules refer to by name ("the pay plan's down payment percentage", "the pay plan's installment fee" and so on).

| Pay plan | Down payment percentage of the full-term premium | Minimum down payment | Months between installment due dates | Installment fee | Minimum installment | Invoice lead days | Renewal bill lead days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Direct Bill Monthly Plan | 20.00 percent | $60.00 | 1 | $8.00 | $15.00 | 20 | 20 |
| Cardinal Card Autopay Monthly Plan | 16.67 percent | $60.00 | 1 | $5.00 | $15.00 | 15 | 20 |
| Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan | 16.67 percent | $60.00 | 1 | $2.00 | $15.00 | 10 | 20 |
| Cardinal Three-Pay Plan | 33.34 percent | $0.00 | 2 | $5.00 | $15.00 | 20 | 25 |
| Cardinal Two-Pay Plan | 50.00 percent | $0.00 | 3 | $5.00 | $15.00 | 20 | 25 |
| Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan | 100.00 percent | $0.00 | 0 (no installments) | $0.00 | $15.00 | 20 | 30 |

## Column notes

- **Months between installment due dates** is the spacing of the installments that follow the down payment. A value of 0 means the plan has no installments and the term is paid in full with the down payment.
- **Minimum installment** is the smallest installment the plan bills.
- **Invoice lead days** are calendar days before each due date on which the invoice, or the autopay draft notice, is issued.
- **Renewal bill lead days** are calendar days before the term expiration date on which the renewal down payment is billed.
- All amounts are in US dollars; all day counts are calendar days.

## Reading the table (hypothetical)

A term on the Cardinal Three-Pay Plan has a down payment and installments falling due every 2 months after it; each invoice is issued 20 calendar days before its due date, and the renewal down payment is billed 25 calendar days before the term expiration date. On the Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan the plan has no installments, so there is no later installment invoice in the term.
